offlineDraft.deviceDraftText:
Case Note

Maria Okonkwo-Reyes was present during the visit, along with Bea. Mould was observed in the back bedroom, exhibiting increased severity near the window. The landlord has not yet responded to two emails sent. A benefits form, with a date of birth of 3/3/87 on the form, was noted, and the deadline was missed last week by she. It was agreed that a phone call to the landlord will be made on Monday. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will submit the form on Friday, and Tomas Brandvold, a neighbor, has offered assistance. The potential risk of rent arrears due to a late submission of the form was discussed. A follow-up visit is scheduled for (place not put back).
